第696章
？我也会喊啊
“真……真君，您怎么亲自来了？”龙涛笑得有些发干。
明烛瞪了他一眼，又回过头去，伸手轻轻揉了揉怜星的头发，那动作利落中带着几分亲昵，像是在安抚一只刚被领进门的小兽。
“怎么？很怕我来？还是船上有什么不能在宗门见人的东西？”
“没有没有，哪能呢，”龙涛赶紧摆手，“就是……其他几位真君还有长老，都已经来看过了，怜星的事，我也早就告诉宗门了啊。”
明烛听后，眼神又冷了一些，
“怎么？他们能来，我就不行？”
“不是不是，当然行，当然行，那您应该看过了吧，没什么问题吧？”
明烛回头看了眼怜星，心中也是感到了震惊，事实上……龙涛都不知道的是，不止几位真君和长老，除了刚刚突破的覆舟之外，其他三位化神老祖，都已经悄悄来看过了。
因为按照龙涛报告上所说，怜星是一个饿鬼，但却又是在饿鬼道的一个特殊乐园里，以人类认知长大，同时还修行着被鬼仙篡改的蛊道，光这些要素，就已经值得大家过来研究了。
更别说她后来还在那位殷哲前辈法宝，和“淆”的命运干涉影响下，和一艘云舟相融合，更关键的是，这艘云舟也不一般，竟然还是当初前往青木妖森的那艘，船体本身被妖森灵气影响，产生了活性。
诸多偶然叠加在一起，诞生了这么一个世上……甚至诸天万界都仅此一例的存在。
事实上，怜星现在已经是被宗门列入特殊至宝级别的存在了，研究什么的先放一边不谈，但绝对是要保护好的大宝贝。
如果不是她把龙涛当成主人的话，宗门早就直接要过来了。
哪怕是现在，高层也和龙涛定了个规矩，平时怜星还是他的船，但暂时……绝对、绝对不能飞出宗门范围，如果龙涛要出门的话，宗门会直接给他一艘更新型的云舟，怜星必须留下，保证安全。
不过说到主人，明烛一下就来脾气了。虽然这事也不能怪他们俩中的任何一个，但作为女人，她当然会很不爽，特别是这个怜星……喊主人的原因，竟然是因为她继承了云舟本身的记忆，这到哪儿说理去。
虽然知道这小子的样子和性格讨女人喜欢，但这是不是有些太邪门了。
不过她也亲自问过怜星的身世，确实没有撒谎，一个可以说得上凄惨，但又挺幸运的孩子。
“嗯，确实看过了，这孩子……虽然暂时还算是你云舟的器灵，但宗门也会好好照顾她的，你别做一些多余的事，你应该明白意思吧。”

“明白明白，我一定注意分寸。”龙涛点头如捣蒜，满脸都是“我懂我懂”。
龙涛当然知道明烛的意思，但她就不看看，怜星的下半身是个植物和血肉混合的蛇形，而且直接连在船身上，根本没有那个部位。
他就算真对人家有什么非分之想，那也要问一句：how？
不过……怜星胸前的某些部位，确实也很雄伟，好像也不是不能……
龙涛脑子里的念头还没想完，就被明烛一个眼神给吓精神了，看她那样子，自己刚才的想法，估计又被看穿了。
明烛缓步走到龙涛身边，靠近时传音道，

"Zhen...Zhenjun, why are you here in person?" Long Tao smiled a little dryly.
Mingzhu glared at him, then turned back and reached out to gently rub Lianxing's hair. There was a hint of intimacy in that move, as if he was comforting a little beast that had just been led in.
"What? Are you afraid that I will come? Or is there something on the ship that cannot be seen in the sect?"
"No, no, how can we," Long Tao waved his hands quickly, "It's just that... several other True Lords and elders have already come to see him, and I have already told the sect about Lian Xing."
After hearing this, Mingzhu's eyes became colder.
"What? They can come, but I can't?"
"No, no, of course, of course, you should have seen it, right? Is there any problem?"
Mingzhu looked back at Lianxing, feeling shocked in his heart. In fact... what Long Tao didn't know was that more than a few True Lords and Elders, except for Fengzhou who had just broken through, the other three ancestors of the God Transformation had quietly come to see him.
Because according to Long Tao's report, Lian Xing is a hungry ghost, but he grew up with human knowledge in a special paradise in the hungry ghost realm. At the same time, he also practiced the Gu Way that was tampered with by ghosts and immortals. These factors alone are worthy of everyone's study.
Not to mention that she later merged with a cloud boat under the influence of senior Yin Zhe's magic weapon and the fateful interference of "Confusion". More importantly, this cloud boat was not ordinary. It was actually the same one that went to the Aoki Demon Forest. The hull itself was affected by the aura of the demon forest and became active.
The superposition of many accidents gave birth to such an existence that is unique in the world... and even in all the worlds.
In fact, Lian Xing is now classified as a special treasure by the sect. Let’s put aside the research for now, but it is definitely a big treasure that must be protected.
If she hadn't regarded Long Tao as her master, the sect would have come directly.
Even now, the senior management has made a rule with Long Tao. Normally, Lianxing is still his ship, but for the time being... he absolutely, absolutely cannot fly out of the sect. If Long Tao wants to go out, the sect will directly give him a newer cloud boat, and Lianxing must stay to ensure safety.
But when it comes to the master, Mingzhu suddenly loses his temper. Although this matter cannot be blamed on either of them, as a woman, she will of course be very unhappy, especially Lianxing... The reason why she calls her master is because she has inherited Yunzhou's own memory. How can this be justified?
Although I know that this guy's appearance and personality are attractive to women, is this a little too evil?
However, she also personally asked about Lian Xing's life experience, and she was indeed not lying. He was a child who could be called miserable, but also very lucky.
"Well, I have indeed seen it. This child... although she is still your Yunzhou's weapon spirit for the time being, the sect will take good care of her. Don't do anything unnecessary. You should understand the meaning."
"I understand, I must pay attention to propriety." Long Tao nodded like garlic, with "I understand, I understand" written all over his face.
Of course Long Tao knew what Mingzhu meant, but she didn't look at it. Ling Xing's lower body was a snake-shaped mixture of plants and flesh, and it was directly connected to the hull, without that part at all.
Even if he really has something wrong with someone, he still has to ask: How?
However...some parts of Lianxing's chest are indeed majestic, and it seems that it's not impossible...
Before Long Tao could finish the thoughts in his mind, he was frightened by Mingzhu's look. Looking at her like that, his thoughts just now were probably seen through again.
